author: MizQuack
quote:
This just in 
GTA 6 fanboys think Zelda players are going out of their way to “review bomb” gta so in turn they’re trying to tank OOTs score. 

Spammers aside, OOT remake was everything it was meant to be and then some. I had the pleasure of growing up with the original 98 version. Instantly had me hooked. When the 3ds version came out, for me honestly it fell flat. It was a repaint and I was really hoping for more. The Ocarina of Time switch 2 remake however didn’t fall short of any expectations. 

Admittedly when I saw the trailer I was a little worried. Some of the character models looked a little wonky. But after not only playing it but seeing all there was to see, I actually really loved the art direction. 

It was moved into a modern style and i was easily spotting elements from other Zelda titles in the art. The quality of life features seem silly but honestly you don’t understand how amazing a jump button really is until you’ve played a game where you did rely on auto jumps. Added cutscenes were beautiful. The music was overhauled and was beautiful. Links fingers even move over the correct slots. 

It’s the attention to detail. The care for the quality of life. The remembrance of the og players along with the consideration of first time players. OOT 98 was a masterpiece but it was crazy outdated. OOT 26 gives you something anyone can hop in and enjoy. It’s a wonderful story and a great starting title for those just getting into Zelda.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: MizQuack
quote: GTA simply isn’t gta anymore. They’ve stripped elements that were simply core gta. Lock you at 30frames. Playing simulator style quests painting walls and buying groceries. Instead of the quests feeling rewarding and compelling it feels like bloatware. People deleted games for this. People waited “a decade” for this. People took time off for this. The amount of people trying to still say it’s amazing while being 12+ hours in saying they “just want to do gta stuff” just goes to show it was the WANT for gta 6 to be good that sold copies. Not the fact that it is. Accepting this after waiting so long simply hurts the cause as a whole. We ask what happened to gaming and then absolutely glaze things that realistically didn’t meet people’s expectations.
